description_en: Creates a custom list. Custom lists are typically referenced by the rule matching engine for values used in various security policies to implement complex logic and control
description_zh: 创建新的自定义列表，这些列表通常用于规则匹配引擎中值的引用，以便在各种安全策略中实现复杂的逻辑和控制
name: CreateList

parameters.help_en:
The name of the custom list.

Naming rules: Only letters, digits, and underscores are supported (`^\w{1,64}$`). The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
自定义列表名称。

命名规则：仅支持字母、数字、下划线（`^\w{1,64}$`），长度 1–64；
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The kind of the custom list. This parameter specifies the type of the custom list
parameters.help_zh: 列表种类，用于指定自定义列表的类型
parameters.name: kind

parameters.help_en: The description of the custom list. This parameter provides detailed information about the custom list
parameters.help_zh: 列表描述，用于提供自定义列表的详细信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The list items. This parameter provides the specific item data for the list
parameters.help_zh: 列表内容，提供具体的列表项数据
parameters.name: items

Id.description_en: The ID of the custom list. You can obtain this value by calling the [ListLists]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850217.html） operation
Id.description_zh: 自定义列表的ID，可通过调用[ListLists]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850217.html）接口获取
